description: This file defines the CounterAggregator class, which is responsible for aggregating counter metrics with associated tags, providing methods to add measurements and collect the current value along with tags.

classes.name: CounterAggregator
classes.description: A class for aggregating counter metrics with optional tags, supporting thread-safe addition and collection of the current count.

methods.name: CounterAggregator()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing an empty tags array.

methods.name: CounterAggregator(in TagList tagList)
methods.description: Constructor initializing tags based on the provided TagList, supporting up to four tags.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Property returning the current aggregated value.

methods.name: Add(long measurement)
methods.description: Method to atomically add a measurement to the current value.

methods.name: Collect()
methods.description: Method to collect the current value along with associated tags as a Measurement.
